chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al-A'ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the man who wears a new garment. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should say: O Allah, make it a garment of bounty and piety and blessing. O Allah, grant me in it the goodness of worshipping You, and an action in obedience to You, and the discharge of gratitude for Your favor. The praise is for Allah, Who clothed me with what I cover my nakedness with and beautify with among the people.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended prayer to say when putting on new clothes in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes a specific dua for wearing new clothes, emphasizing the transformation of a physical item into a spiritual vessel for piety (taqwa) and gratitude. It reflects the Shia emphasis on infusing daily acts with divine remembrance, linking the external act of dressing with internal spiritual states. The supplication acknowledges Allah as the provider of modesty and social dignity, reinforcing the concept of 'kiswa' as both a physical covering and a symbol of divine favor.
